name: Solex Energy Ltd
tagline: Recently mainboard-migrated solar-module manufacturer whose post-crash 'statistically cheap' thesis was tested by an actual Q1FY27 print and found wanting - PAT down 66.6% YoY, FY26 revenue guidance missed twice over, cell-line funding shrunk and shifted from QIP to structured debt, and the capacity vision quietly moderated from '15GW by 2030' to '10GW module by FY30'; real capacity/order-book scale remains but four_box score falls to 2.5 and thesis_fit moves to 'neither' pending H2FY27 delivery
business_overview: Incorporated 1995, Solex Energy manufactures solar photovoltaic cells and modules and does EPC in the solar-energy market, based in Gujarat. Completed SME-to-mainboard migration (Oct 2025). Module capacity reached 4GW after Lines 3 & 4 (2.5GW combined) commissioned end-Oct/Nov 2025. A 2GW N-Type TOPCon Plus cell line, originally targeted for FY26 then FY27, is still pre-commissioning as of Sep 2026 - land procured, awaiting a 30MW power-connection approval from the Gujarat government, funding shifted from a Rs 1,500 Cr QIP+debt plan to a smaller ~Rs 1,050 Cr structured-debt-led plan (~Rs 700 Cr debt via an SBI-led consortium + ~Rs 350 Cr equity), debt due diligence completed and at final evaluation as of the Q1FY27 concall, target commissioning March 2027. Longer-dated: a proposed Rs 4,000 Cr integrated solar-cell + BESS (battery storage) facility in Gujarat, with the capacity vision now framed as 4GW -> 10GW module by FY30 (moderated from an earlier '15GW by 2030' framing). (Source: external-lead, @ankitbahuguna84, untrusted X triage, first_seen 2026-09-04; fundamentals updated via deep-dive pass 1, 2026-09-22.)

fundamentals_narrative: Genuine capacity and revenue scale-up (module capacity 700MW -> 4GW in ~2 years; FY26 revenue Rs 1,621 Cr, +144% YoY) at a market cap that has been cut by ~64.5% from its Nov-2025 peak (Rs 1,985 -> ~Rs 704) - a much sharper correction than the pass-0 file's '46%' figure captured. But the post-crash 'statistically cheap' thesis has now been tested by an actual earnings print rather than just sentiment: Q1FY27 PAT collapsed 66.6% YoY as new-capacity depreciation and finance cost stepped up ahead of the revenue ramp, EBITDA margin compressed to 12.7% from 16.4%, and ALMM-clarity delays pushed customer deliveries into H2FY27 (a rescheduling, per management, not cancellations). FY26 revenue also missed guidance twice over (Rs 2,000+ Cr original, then a revised ~Rs 1,850 Cr H1-concall guide, against an actual Rs 1,621 Cr) - a guidance-credibility problem not visible in the pass-0 read. The cell line has slipped again (funding shrunk from Rs 1,500 Cr to ~Rs 1,050 Cr and shifted from QIP to structured debt; still pre-financial-close as of Sep 2026), ROE/ROCE both declined YoY, rising debtor days signal continuing working-capital strain (though this conflicts with the company's own claimed WC-cycle improvement), and the community's genuine, unresolved oversupply/commoditisation concern is reinforced by management's own acknowledgement that Chinese manufacturers remain aggressive on price. Management's own FY28 aspiration (Rs 4,500 Cr revenue, 5-6% margin) is itself below FY26's actual margin - an implicit admission that near-term margins are not a clean run-rate. Real capacity and order-book scale remain (Rs 3,400 Cr order book, Rs 845.84 Cr near-term executable pipeline), so this stays a name to re-underwrite rather than avoid, but it no longer clears the bar for the return-magnitude label it carried in pass 0.
technical_read: Not pulled - fundamentals/thread read gave enough signal; stock already near 52-week lows post-correction.

verdict_headline: Post-correction 'cheap' thesis has now been tested by an actual earnings print, not just sentiment - Q1FY27 confirmed the market's scepticism with a 66.6% PAT collapse and margin compression, FY26 revenue missed guidance twice, and the cell-line/vision has been quietly scaled back (funding shrunk + shifted to debt, 15GW vision moderated to 10GW). four_box falls to 2.5 (valuation box downgraded) -> thesis_fit moves to 'neither'; conviction cut to Low pending a genuine H2FY27 delivery track record.
verdict_reasoning: four_box: tailwind weak (real India solar demand but a genuine, now-reinforced industry oversupply/'adding' capital-cycle risk - Chinese pricing pressure plus simultaneous domestic capacity adds including by Solex itself), tam yes (FY26's Rs 1,621 Cr base and the Rs 4,500 Cr FY28 aspiration / 10GW-by-FY30 roadmap still give real headroom, though the vision was moderated from 15GW), moat weak (commodity module manufacturing, unchanged), valuation DOWNGRADED from yes to weak (statistically cheap at ~10.3x trailing P/E, but Q1FY27's confirmed earnings collapse plus declining ROE/ROCE mean the 'cheapness' is now backed by deteriorating, not merely depressed, fundamentals) -> score 2.5

Score 2.0-2.5 band defaults to thesis_fit 'neither' unless a written exception (valuation=yes, un-ignorable growth, or the large-cap named-inflection carve-out); none apply here - growth has decelerated sharply (Q1FY27 +1.8% YoY vs FY26's +144%), not un-ignorable, and the valuation box is no longer clean, so thesis_fit moves to 'neither'

Conviction cut from Low-Medium (PRE) to Low (POST): two consecutive guidance misses (FY26 actual Rs 1,621 Cr vs Rs 2,000+ Cr original and ~Rs 1,850 Cr revised guidance) plus a confirmed Q1FY27 PAT collapse (-66.6% YoY) materially weaken guidance credibility and earnings quality versus the pass-0 read
